description: TCP 数据集专属适配，按该数据集的命名、目录或表字段约定选择处理方法。支持：tcp 表型/刺激提取；tcp 质控汇总；tcp 数据校验；FSL 完整结构预处理（fsl_anat）；fMRIPrep 本地环境执行；混杂回归与去趋势；ROI 时间序列与功能连接；任务态一级 GLM；其他方法可在详情中分页查询。

method_refs.label: tcp 表型/刺激提取
method_refs.role: Extract and merge TCP phenotype data. Reads TCP phenotype files (diagnosis, dimensional measures) and produces a merged phenotype table aligned with imaging subject list。 Inputs: phenotype_files: 文件路径清单（每行一项） (file); imaging_ids: imaging-ids (file). Registered outputs: results/output.csv.

method_refs.label: tcp 质控汇总
method_refs.role: Generate per-subject QC summaries for TCP processing. Transdiagnostic: tracks diagnostic group and applies appropriate QC criteria。 Inputs: fmriprep_dir: Path to fMRIPrep output directory (directory). Registered outputs: results/output.csv.

method_refs.label: tcp 数据校验
method_refs.role: Validate TCP BIDS structure and generate compliance report. Checks directory structure, modality completeness, and diagnostic group labeling。 Inputs: input: input (directory). Registered outputs: results/output.csv.

method_refs.label: FSL 完整结构预处理（fsl_anat）

execution_resolution.reason: 选择原文委托的具体结构处理入口；不同流程分别列出，按用户所需范围执行。

method_refs.role: Invoke the existing FSL fsl_anat workflow on a T1-weighted image and retain its structural.anat directory, including the bias-corrected brain image。 Inputs: input: T1w NIfTI (file). Registered outputs: results/structural.anat/T1_biascorr_brain.nii.gz. Fixed invocation options: --operation fsl-anat.

method_refs.default_reason: 配置 LOCALFLOW_FMRIPREP_EXECUTABLE 后可直接运行，不向后端开放 Docker socket。

selection_rules: 先确认目标产物、允许使用的已有输入与禁止复用的结果；仅在用户允许时复用已有数据，不默认追加上游步骤。
独立操作选择 Method；确需固定组合时选择 Pipeline，并检查每一步输入输出。
软件工具 Skill 用于选择实现，任务 Skill 用于组织需求，不因为同时匹配两类 Skill 重复添加方法。

Treat missing inputs according to the current goal: for explicitly requested steps, ask for binding or discuss alternatives; when asked to produce a target from stated inputs, add only necessary available producers allowed by the user. Never regenerate an explicitly reused result or silently broaden the scientific goal.

Select by scientific output meaning, stage conditions and spatial/data requirements. A directory, generic image or report does not certify a typed derivative. Do not equate tissue classes, anatomical atlas regions and learned clusters. Query the Method contract for exact ports and conditional parameters; use Pipelines only when their actual steps match the request.
name: tcp-skill
applicability: 输入必须符合 TCP 对应脚本的数据发布格式和字段约定；通用影像处理请选软件或任务 Skill。
根据目标选择对应 Method 或 Pipeline；每个入口的输入格式、必要参数和产物以其独立契约为准。
limitations: 格式和样本数量满足仅是必要条件；空间、单位、样本标识与方法假设仍须按所选方法检查。
这里只统筹已登记入口；目录收录不代表覆盖软件全部命令或参数。
环境探测与运行证据分别显示；合成数据测试不代表真实数据的科学有效性。
尚无 Method 的规划能力只能提供说明，不能当作可执行步骤。
